description: Get full details for one hosted app — status, subdomain/URL, repo, runtime, and database/domain config. Use the appId from vibekit_list_apps.
name: vibekit_get_app

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: App details: subdomain, status, live URL, container stats, and infrastructure topology.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Get App
